full_name: Bridie Andrews | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: An assistant professor of the history of medicine at Harvard, Bridie Andrews is interested in the history of Chinese medicine; gender in Asian history, science, and medicine; and East Asia in the modern world order.
